package_type: Final ML and Data Research Package
important_scientific_notes: WPI is an index and should not be described as direct supplier price.
Supplier/order dataset is synthetic and should be labeled as a simulation/proof-of-concept.
Test data must not be used for model tuning.
Transport-rate and shortage-penalty values are experimental assumptions unless replaced by sourced real values.
Demand forecasting should not be claimed as empirically validated without real historical order data.
